about: OH's regional seed (Lane D1; rewritten 2026-10-02 on review R4's ruling F4), the kit's region section (scripts/demo-kit/lib/region.mjs, validated by lib/config.mjs) over the four dimensions of OH's regional allowlist (category, type, sizeBand, fuel; priceTier left out by the same ruling, so no price tier leads by region until LG's own rows exist), with the exact values of public/oh/products.json. Synthetic and representative: not a claim about any state's market and never LG's sales; labelled synthetic → warehouse wherever it shows, until LG's regional rows replace it. NO CENSUS FIGURE SHAPES ANY ROW: every state and DC is written verbatim under rehearsed, so the kit never calls its income-tilt model; the model block below is inert, present only because the kit's config schema requires one (its blend names a single dimension and its extras are empty; buildRegions refuses a census file of any other size than 51, so no region can fall through to it). Each state's TV rows take fixed shares, and which TV type (oled, qned, uhd) and which size band (55-64, 65-74, 75-82) lead is a seeded pseudo-random assignment: FNV-1a of "oh-region-lean-v1|<region key>" seeding mulberry32, stable across runs; leans lists the outcome. Appliance rows are one national mix in every state, except cooking fuel: gas about 70% in California and New Jersey and a third elsewhere, so about 38% of households nationally; dryers 80% electric everywhere (lg-buying-journeys.md §2, EIA RECS via NPGA). The census still answers the panel's "census shown, never scored" row; it scores nothing and shaped nothing here. The cold-start route's own vocabulary (the OH config's seed vocabulary) should equal `vocabulary` here.

assignment.method: FNV-1a of "<seed>|<region key>" seeding mulberry32; a Fisher-Yates shuffle of [oled, qned, uhd] gives the type order, then one draw over [55-64, 65-74, 75-82] the lead band
